game_title: Flowchart Lab · Find the larger number
game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Ore Smelter, a smelter processing glowing ore: the lava scout must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Divide Or Floor: Pick / or // to split heat shields evenly among allies without leaving fractions.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ore Smelter: a smelter processing glowing ore
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read a and b. Display a when a is greater than b; otherwise display b. Test dataset 4: {'a': 9, 'b': 4}; {'a': -4, 'b': -6}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Divide Or Floor' (Week 2 slot 4), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Ore Smelter'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Protect the fire shrine from cinder bats in Ore Smelter: keep the share meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 76-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: share drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 76-second timer ends.
source_game_title: Divide Or Floor – Ore Smelter Defense
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
